description: Stable four-digit municipality identifier used for every join.
transformation: Left-pad numeric representations to four digits.
missing_data_rule: Never missing for an accepted panel row.

description: Plain-language display name assigned from the municipality code.
transformation: Map only after joining on municipality_code.
missing_data_rule: Never missing for a target code.

description: Municipality label exactly as distributed in the source sheet.
transformation: Trim surrounding whitespace; otherwise preserve.
missing_data_rule: Retain source text even when the display name differs.

description: Year named by the annual Summary sheet.
transformation: Parse the leading four-digit year from the sheet name.
missing_data_rule: Must be one of 2015 through 2025.

description: Population value reported on the annual Summary sheet.
transformation: Convert numeric source value; do not interpolate.
missing_data_rule: 'No data' becomes null, never zero.

description: Full annual source header identifying the population vintage.
transformation: Preserve source header text.
missing_data_rule: Never missing when the workbook contract passes.

description: Gross debt less deductions, as reported by NJ DCA.
transformation: Convert numeric source value and round to cents; no inflation adjustment.
missing_data_rule: 'No data' becomes null; reported numeric zero stays zero.

description: Per-capita net debt distributed in the source workbook.
transformation: Retain the reported numeric value; do not replace mismatches.
missing_data_rule: 'No data' becomes null.

description: Audit comparison: reported net debt divided by reported population.
transformation: net_debt / population_estimate when both are available.
missing_data_rule: Null when either input is unavailable or population is not positive.

description: Previous calendar year's tax levy that was collected.
transformation: Multiply the source fraction by 100.
missing_data_rule: 'No data' becomes null.

description: Calendar year named in the tax-collection source header.
transformation: Parse the four-digit CY year from the header.
missing_data_rule: Never missing when the workbook contract passes.

description: Source flag that NJ DCA has no User-Friendly Budget on file.
transformation: X becomes true; blank becomes false.
missing_data_rule: Blank means the flag is not asserted, not that all data are complete.

description: Source flag that at least one entire UFB section was blank.
transformation: X becomes true; blank becomes false.
missing_data_rule: Blank means the flag is not asserted.

description: Combined explanation of source flags and explicit 'No data' fields.
transformation: Concatenate only observed source evidence; do not infer a cause.
missing_data_rule: Blank when no source missingness evidence is present.

description: Total of source-identified structural imbalances including offsets.
transformation: Convert numeric source value and round to cents.
missing_data_rule: 'No data' becomes null; retained as audit-only in v0.1.

description: Three-year average total property valuation distributed by NJ DCA.
transformation: Convert numeric cached source value; make no scale repair.
missing_data_rule: 'No data' becomes null; 2024 target values are audit-only.

description: Source net debt divided by three-year average property valuation.
source_field: Net Debt as % of 3 Year Avg Property Valuation
transformation: Multiply the source fraction by 100; retain in the audit download but exclude from charts, summary tables, and interpretive claims.
missing_data_rule: 'No data' becomes null; 2024 values remain audit-only.

description: Whether a reported net-debt point may appear in the public chart/table.
transformation: False for source flags, missing debt, or an unreconciled isolated zero.
missing_data_rule: Never null.

description: Visible reason a net-debt observation is not displayed.
transformation: Concatenate applicable evidence-based exclusion reasons.
missing_data_rule: Blank when the observation is eligible.

description: Whether a tax-collection value may appear in the latest-valid table.
transformation: False for source flags or missing tax-collection value.
missing_data_rule: Never null.

description: Visible reason a tax-collection observation is not displayed.
transformation: Concatenate applicable evidence-based exclusion reasons.
missing_data_rule: Blank when the observation is eligible.

description: Workbook filename used for the observation.
transformation: Assign the pinned source filename.
missing_data_rule: Never missing.

description: Annual source sheet containing the observation.
transformation: Preserve the exact sheet name.
missing_data_rule: Never missing.

description: One-based row number in the annual source sheet.
transformation: Record during extraction.
missing_data_rule: Never missing.
